text: Riu Kujou
I'm Riu Kujou. As you can see, I'm a maid.
I'm 19 years old.
Riu Kujou rubs her stiff face and shifts her gaze from the lens pointing right at her and looks irritably at me filming her with the action camera.
Great, the tenth filming attempt is now also a failure.
I'm afraid we can't, Riu. Your self-introduction is a crucial part of this interview. On that day, Chihori Terasaki specifically indicated that this part must be completed or else it won't count.
Why did she agree to this? To find out, we'll need to revisit what happened three days ago.
Chihori Terasaki
Yes.
Have you made a mistake? I'm not a celebrity. I'm just a maid.
I'm doing a special report on modern professional maids this time. I've heard a lot about you from {var:player_nickname}, who tells me you're an exceptional maid.
Chihori Terasaki looks at me next to her as she says this, and I nod in response.
Riu really is the most amazing maid I've ever met.
I've come because I want to interview you. What do you say?
I won't make you do this for free. This will be your pay.
As if she already expected that she would be rejected, Chihori Terasaki calmly takes out a photo of a plushie and pushes it in front of Riu Kujou.
I've heard that you have a habit of collecting teddy bears. Although this teddy is no longer available on the market, my friend just gave me one. It'll be yours if you agree to do the interview.
Riu Kujou makes an extremely tempted expression.
Haha, you won't need to do anything difficult. I mainly want to know what the life of a maid is really like, so I want my reporter to follow you around for one day.
Don't worry, we'll make sure to hide anything that will give away your address and location, and all materials will be used with your consent.
I understand.
Well, this wouldn't be a problem if the reporter who follows you is someone who you and Miss Mikami already know, right?
Wait! Hold on! Are you both thinking what I'm thinking?
In the end, I was given the important task of following and filming Riu Kujou for one day.

Correspondingly, since Chihori Terasaki wouldn't be able to get one of her reporters to follow and film Riu Kujou, she proposed that she would decide whether to give Riu Kujou the teddy bear after reviewing the quality of the filmed content.
Yes...
Everything is difficult at the beginning. Stick with it for the teddy bear, Riu!
Okay!
I adjust the machine and start filming again.
Riu Kujou's face is still bright red, so we can't continue filming anymore, and my head starts to hurt when I look at the lines prepared for the interview. How should I go about this now?
Insist on trying a few more times because practice makes perfect
Suggest filming another part first
We won't get anywhere if we keep wasting time like this. We should try something else if this isn't working.
Let's film this part later.
Riu Kujou breathes an obvious sigh of relief and glances at the time.
I was starting to worry that we would spend the entire morning doing this and wouldn't be able to complete the work I had scheduled.
If we do that, we really will lose sight of everything else for this. Just pretend that I don't exist from now on and focus on what you need to do. I'll be responsible for filming some good stuff.
Riu Kujou pats my shoulder sincerely and earnestly.
Umm, I'll just be filming you. It's not hard work. Please start doing your work now.
The first thing she'll do is the laundry for her lady? Exceptional cleaning abilities are a key trait of a good maid, so I must film this.
Riu Kujou looks worriedly at me who is about to put down the action camera and sit down.

Half an hour later, I'm leaning against a shelf in a supermarket with a full shopping cart, while Riu Kujou is still picking products not far from me. I put down the action camera and rub my sore arms.
That's what I felt the first time I met Miss Kujou, but she seems to be managing things well over these years.
I turn my head and see Sawako Kitami standing next to me behind a shopping cart, and she is looking at us with raised eyebrows. I have no idea when she got here.
Sawako Kitami
It's such a coincidence. I came over to say hi because I saw Miss Kujou and wasn't expecting to see you here.
Yes, we got to know each other because we often go to the same supermarket, choose foods together, and share recipes with each other.
I see.
I must admit that One Han City is a really small place sometimes.
So what are you filming? Something like a vlog?
I tell her what we're doing.
Hmm? I can't wait.

When she finally gave it to the children to try, they pointed at the bear sushi that she spent a lot of time making and said, "These piglets are so cute." Miss Kujou was depressed for quite some time after that.
Oh, there you are, Miss Kujou. I was just telling {var:player_nickname} cute stories about you. Your interview will definitely be a smashing success.
Hmm? Okay, let's go.
Hmm?
After receiving a sharp glare from Riu Kujou, I put away my dangerous curiosity.
Chiori Mikami's House
No, you have to eat everything.
But isn't this too much food?
I look at the two large plates of salmon in front of me that are basically untouched as I complain weakly.

I ended up buying so much food to attract Ms. Kitami's attention because you were filming all sorts of strange things in the supermarket just now. That's why you have to eat everything while it's fresh.
I rub my bulging belly and find myself really missing Ichihime right now. Sigh, I should have brought her with me today.
Anyway, I'm leaving all of this to you. Let's stop filming for today.
You can find a place to play mahjong in the afternoon. You can come over and film the self-introduction later.

I take some time to look at the interview outline, and it really doesn't say that we need to film Riu's personal activities. On that day, all Chihori Terasaki said was that we should film content that viewers would be interested in watching.
Keep filming Riu Kujou
Play mahjong
Riu, can I keep you company during your personal time in the afternoon?

Huh? Are you sure you want to film me when I'm not working as a maid? The interview guidelines don't say anything about that though. I already feel bad about making you help me, so isn't it better to avoid unnecessary work?
I don't know about anyone else, but if I'm a reader, if I'm watching this interview, I'll be watching it because I want to know what Riu Kujou is like when she isn't working as a maid.
At least that's what I think.
Sure!
The first thing I do after finishing my work is to do some daily physical exercise here.

To my surprise, the first place Riu Kujou takes me to is a Taekwondo dojo, and I'm completely astonished to see a photo of Riu Kujou wearing a Taekwondo dobok and beating her opponent to the ground on the wall of the dojo.
In other words, you're stronger than your dan indicates, right...
After doing some physical exercise, I usually take a stroll and buy whatever catches my eye along the way.

For example, I might go to the tailor shop to buy fabric to make a beautiful dress for Miss Chiori, I might go to a household goods store to look for new housekeeping tools, or I might go to the bookstore to search for more useful schedule planners, new cookbooks, recent best-selling organization guides, etc.
Most girls don't go shopping for these things!
Fully satisfied with a bag full of fabrics, daily necessities, and books, Riu Kujou suddenly stops walking.
Hmm? Is it time to go back?
I follow Riu Kujou's gaze and see a tea house next to a road.

Well, I only learned how to make tea before because it's a basic skill of a maid. I only started to really pay attention to the tea ceremony after chatting with my teacher about the tea ceremony at the Mahjong Soul Shrine last time.
Haha, thanks!
Ah, my bag! Help! There's a thief!

Suddenly, an urgent shout stops us in our tracks, and a figure runs past us quickly. Before I can react, Riu Kujou's bursting shopping bag suddenly appears in my hand, and she is already chasing after the figure.
I quickly grab my action camera and chase after them. After passing an intersection, I arrive just in time to see Riu Kujou kick the thief to the ground with a horizontal kick.
There are gasps of surprise all around us.
Passerby A
Passerby B
Passerby C
While the passers-by are chatting excitedly amongst themselves, Riu Kujou takes the bag back from the thief and hands it to the owner who catches up to us quickly.
Here you go. Let's call the police so they can take the thief to the police station.
Bag Owner
Riu Kujou hurries over to me and pats my shoulder.
Let's run!
Huh?
As she speaks, Riu Kujou runs off into the distance like an arrow. Suddenly, I find myself surrounded by a large crowd.
Are you her companion?
Argh! Who is she? Can you tell me?
Are you filming something? Is she a star? Or is she an Internet celebrity? Please tell me her name!
We've already filmed a lot in the morning, and it's probably not that convenient for me to film her during her own time.
During the brief time I was thinking, Riu Kujou actually sorted the delicacies on the table neatly and packed them into a bento box for me.
Take this. I'll see you in the evening.
Sigh, it's such a shame that I didn't manage to film the special packing technique she used.
It is already evening by the time I finish feeding Ichihime and return to Chiori's house with a big bag of snacks that Ichihime insisted I bring with me.
I don't know where Riu Kujou went when she was enjoying herself, but she looks a lot more relaxed, and we manage to film her self-introduction successfully.
Several days later
Huh? Isn't this good enough?

Well, I can say that the content is unremarkable. These are all things the audience will immediately think of when they see the theme. Although her various skills are amazing, they don't stand out enough when compared with what you can find on the Internet nowadays.
I don't think there's a need to publish this content at all. Sorry, I don't really mince my words.
However, when we meet Chihori Terasaki again at the Mahjong Soul Shrine, she makes some very sharp comments after seeing the material.
Riu Kujou lowers her head silently and is very disappointed with the result. Feeling bad for her, I ask Chihori Terasaki a question.
It's too late for that. We don't get much time to choose a theme for the special report, so I've already prepared something else instead.

{var:player_nickname}, based on what you told me about Miss Kujou, I got the impression that she's very interesting as a person. It's a shame that you didn't manage to capture the things that make her shine.
But I know you two worked very hard. Since I asked Miss Kujou to help me, I'll give her that teddy bear.
Riu Kujou comes back to life immediately after hearing that she will still get the teddy bear, which makes me feel less uneasy.

However, I still have some regrets when I think about Chihori Terasaki's words. I guess it's true that not everyone can be a reporter. I'll have to capture Riu Kujou's brilliance slowly and privately in the future.
Shall we try again after you get more familiar with the lines?
After that, Riu Kujou prepared for a while before we started filming again.
How was it?
Huh? Is it bad? Let me see.
I don't know what to say when I'm watching the playback. Riu Kujou takes the action camera from me and presses the play button.
Argh! No! As the best maid, I'll be humiliated if this video of me looking so stiff is released! No, I can't let this happen!
Huh? Huh? Don't press the delete button. We tried so many times before we managed to film this!!!
In the end, Riu Kujou lost her confidence to complete the filming after seeing her terrible performance.
Yes, I understand.
I sigh out loud after saying goodbye to Chihori Terasaki.
...My hobbies? ...Do I have to say that? Umm... this is really awkward...
Hey, {var:player_nickname}... Can we skip this part?

Don't rush, don't rush... Filming a video is different from playing mahjong--it's not a big deal to start over since there are no point limitations... I comfort myself as I put down the action camera and point at the interview outline that I've almost torn to pieces after flipping through it so many times.
player
Sigh... geez... I must have lost my mind... Why did I agree to something like this...?
...An interview?
Thanks, but it'll probably disrupt the daily schedule that Miss Chiori and I follow... You should ask someone else.
Oh my!!! Isn't this...
...What do I need to do for the interview?
Wow... that sounds sooo reassuring.
But just the idea of being followed and filmed by a stranger for one day is a little...
Hmm... it's unsettling just thinking about it...
Someone we already know...?
I see! If you know the person doing the filming, it won't be awkward anymore since it isn't a stranger... Huh? Why are you both looking at me?
Sigh... I thought it would be really easy, but there's actually such a formal interview element to complete.

Looking back at the past few failed recording sessions, the first time was because Riu Kujou spoke too softly, the second time was because she didn't remember the interview questions and kept looking at the little card in her hand, and the third time was because she got too nervous and said she wasn't nervous... Without realizing it, we had already spent an hour on the opening self-introduction.
You're right... it's not like me at all to be so depressed. Ahem, I'm ready. Let's try again!
I'm Riu Kujou. As you can see, I'm a... ARGHH! It's not working!
...This isn't working... When I look at the lens, I feel like someone is controlling my body, then I forget the lines I've prepared, and my mind goes blank...
Phew... I'm so happy to hear that.
I understand. Then... I'll leave it to you.
Next up is... opening parcels and sorting letters? ...Wow, she's really fast. I need to film this from various angles too...
Done...! Huh? Is she going to vacuum the whole house without taking a break first...? Well, this is a big occasion that can't be missed.
The living room is done... The bedrooms are done... Phew... the garden is also done... This is great. I've filmed everything... I can finally sit down and rest now, right... What? You're going out?
Yes, I need to buy some household things from the supermarket... Are you still okay?
...Of course I'm okay! Don't underestimate my stamina!
Phew...
A maid's work is really busy. I can't believe you have so many things to do in the morning... Are you sure you won't get worn out...?
...Huh? Sawako Kitami?
Oh yes... speaking of it, I remember that you live around here, Ms. Sawako. So you and Riu know each other?
About this...
Pfft... I get it now. Someone as cute as Miss Kujou does deserve her own story. Ah, an idea just came to me. Why don't you add something like friends' stories of her to your interview?
Haha, not long after I first met Miss Kujou, she saw a photo of an animal-shaped sushi I posted on 「CatChat」, and she said she wanted to come to my place to learn how to make it...
Pfft, so there was a time when her cooking skills were like that...
I know, right? You have no idea how cute she looked when she practiced making sushi so seriously... Oh, there's one more thing! Not long ago...
...? M-Ms. Kitami!
Haha... thanks... Oh yes, they just brought out some salmon over there, and they look really fresh. Do you want to take a look with me?
Eh, I haven't heard enough yet...
Ahaha... don't worry about it... Go and check out the salmon...
I-I can't eat anymore...
...Sigh... okay then...
Huh...? Aren't we doing any filming in the afternoon?

Well... if there's nothing I need to do urgently in the afternoon, I usually use that time to take care of some personal matters that have nothing to do with my job as a maid. So it's okay if we don't record this.
I see...
Well then, the next thing is...

Although the interview outline doesn't provide clear guidelines on what we should film, I remember that Chihori Terasaki said we should think about what viewers would be interested in watching when we choose what to film... With this thought in mind, I suddenly know what to do.
No... the guidelines don't say anything about this, but I want to do it.
...What I'm like... when I'm not working as a maid?

Yes, after all, a maid's work is pretty routine, so more vivid things like what Miss Riu Kujou is like during her own time, why she chose this job, and how she balances her career with her personal life are more interesting, right?
...Okay then. I don't really mind as long as you don't think it's too much work... In that case, let's go. I'll show you what I do during my personal time.
...Your idea of daily exercise is a spar between Taekwondo black belt martial artists?
I just have a third-dan black belt. I started learning it in case I would need it to stop someone from bullying Miss Chiori, but I stopped taking the exams later.
To my joy, I realize that Riu Kujou has actually been going easy on me all the time...
Yes, I thought so because most girls like to go shopping.
Now that I've visited these stores and bought the things I want...
Well, that's what I used to do, but I've started doing one more thing I like recently--coming here to rest.
Oh... a tea house?
After learning the tea ceremony, I feel calm and refreshed whenever I make tea... Huh? Why are you looking at me like that?
Nothing... I'm just thinking that doing this interview has given me the chance to learn about so many different sides of you. I'm really happy after hearing so much from you.
R-Really? You get happy over such strange things... Let's go. I'll take you there for a cup of tea. You've worked really hard today to film everything.
Wow... she's so cool! This looks like something from a movie!
Amazing... Is she a police officer? Why is she wearing a maid outfit?
Is she a cosplayer? Or does she work at a maid café? I really want her contact details...
Thanks a lot! Thank you so much...
Umm... What's your name? How can I contact you later?
Oh... I just helped out since I was here. You don't need to know my name. I'm just an ordinary maid.
A-A maid... Wait up!
Umm... Sorry... sorry... she really is just a maid... Excuse me... umm... stop crowding around me... Ahhh! Ri... Miss Maid! Wait for me!!!

On that day, Riu Kujou and I managed to successfully complete the filming mission that Chihori Terasaki assigned to us... Riu Kujou got the teddy bear she wanted, and I got something even more precious--I got to see sides of Riu Kujou that make her more real and vivid to me than ever.
You're right. In that case, go and do what you want to do, Riu. I'll go to the Mahjong Soul Shrine to play some mahjong. I'll see you later... Huh? When did you pack all this?
...Okay.
But...
Hmm... this won't do.
I see...
...Umm, if you give us another chance to film this...
Oh...
...Huh? Really? That's wonderful! Thank you so much! But I can pay you back for it. Do you want me to pay you back by card or by cash? I don't mind!
Okay...
Phew, I finally managed to say all my lines completely this time...
Well...
I'm... this person who is stiff all over and smiling falsely?
Ahem, it's not as bad as you make it sound...
I see... it's okay. I thought this might happen.

As for whether I won't have anything to publish in the magazine... Haha, you don't need to worry about that because I have a backup plan. But since she didn't finish the interview, please help me tell her that I can't give her the teddy bear.

I knew it. The role of a temporary reporter was too difficult for a Jyanshi like me after all. I couldn't help Riu Kujou get the teddy bear, so all I can do now is to play mahjong with her more often to cheer her up.
